description: The JoergSprave channel primarily features demonstrations and tests of the host's self-built, often highly exotic slingshots and other weapons. The videos showcase these devices launching unconventional projectiles like saw blades, arrows, or even Oreo cookies, while also covering the construction and modification of crossbows, knives, and air guns. Beyond pure entertainment, the content often serves to showcase and promote products from the host's own weapons trading company, GoGun GmbH.
